lines: You can pull an all-nighter, and still blank on the test.
Everything you study lands in short-term storage first.
Then, while you sleep, your brain saves it for the long term.
Skip the sleep, and a lot of it never gets saved.
So study earlier, in short bursts, and quiz yourself.
That's Unspool. Your notes as short reels with quizzes, so you're done before midnight.
Try it free, at unspool dot c c.
